elements.title: Correlation Heatmap for Variables in Car Crashes Dataset
elements.details: Heatmap chart showing correlation coefficients between numeric variables in the car_crashes dataset. Variables on both axes include: 'total', 'speeding', 'alcohol', 'not_distracted', 'no_previous', 'ins_premium', 'ins_losses', 'abbrev'. Correlation values range from -1 to 1, with color intensity in Reds palette indicating strength and direction. Annotated values visible on each cell, e.g., 'total' correlates 1.00 with itself, 0.57 with 'speeding', 0.44 with 'alcohol', etc. The heatmap visually highlights positive and negative correlations among variables.
elements.summary: This heatmap visualizes the correlation matrix of numeric variables in the car crashes dataset, showing the strength and direction of linear relationships between pairs of variables.
